title: Platform–Orbit Capability Registry
description: First-wave capability registry defining the boundary between conxius-platform (control plane) and conxius-orbit (execution surface). Each capability record includes ownership, schema references, side-effect classification, authentication expectations, and retryability semantics.

capabilities.name: Deployment Orchestration
capabilities.description: Top-level deployment orchestration that emits deployment manifests, coordinates cross-repo artifact assembly, and triggers chain-specific execution.

inputSchema.description: Deployment manifest describing what to deploy, where, and with what evidence.

outputSchema.description: Verification result produced after deployment gate checks.

capabilities.authentication: GitHub Actions OIDC or platform service account
capabilities.retryability: idempotent — retry with same manifest produces same target state

capabilities.name: Environment Promotion
capabilities.description: Gates and executes environment promotion (e.g. staging → production) based on verification results and lifecycle control checks.

inputSchema.description: Verification result that gates promotion eligibility.

outputSchema.description: Updated deployment manifest reflecting the promoted target environment.

capabilities.authentication: GitHub Actions OIDC with promotion gate approval
capabilities.retryability: idempotent — promotion to same target with same evidence is safe to retry

capabilities.name: Deployment Verification
capabilities.description: Cross-repo verification gate that validates deployment manifests against lifecycle, security, and integrity controls.

outputSchema.description: Structured verification result with per-check status and evidence.

capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — verification is a pure read-side check

capabilities.name: Lifecycle Control Gate
capabilities.description: Enforces repository lifecycle controls including submodule integrity, production boundary guards, and contamination checks.

inputSchema.description: Repository metadata, branch protection state, and workflow conformance signals.

outputSchema.description: Gate result with pass/fail per lifecycle check.

capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — gate evaluation is deterministic

capabilities.name: Control-Plane Telemetry
capabilities.description: Ingests and aggregates cross-repo telemetry, deployment status, and system health signals for the control-plane dashboard.

inputSchema.description: Prometheus metrics, deployment status events, and system health probes.

outputSchema.description: Aggregated dashboard feeds and alerting signals.

capabilities.authentication: Prometheus service account with read-scoped tokens
capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — metric collection is lossy-tolerant

capabilities.name: Chain-Specific Deployment
capabilities.description: Executes deployment of contracts, configurations, and services onto a specific target chain (Stacks, Bitcoin L2, etc.).

inputSchema.description: Platform-issued deployment manifest with target chain and artifact references.

outputSchema.description: Chain-specific verification result confirming deployment outcome.

capabilities.authentication: Chain-specific deployer key (non-custodial, no protocol-signing custody)
capabilities.retryability: conditional — retry safe if previous attempt failed before on-chain confirmation; requires idempotency check

capabilities.name: Chain-Aware Monitoring
capabilities.description: Monitors deployed contracts and services on target chains, reporting health, block height, and transaction confirmation status.

inputSchema.description: Chain RPC endpoints, contract addresses, and health probe configuration.

outputSchema.description: Monitoring events and health metrics consumable by platform telemetry.

capabilities.authentication: Read-only chain RPC access (no signing keys)
capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — monitoring is continuous and lossy-tolerant

capabilities.name: Diagnostic Operations
capabilities.description: Runs diagnostic checks against deployed contracts and chain state to surface anomalies, configuration drift, or performance degradation.

inputSchema.description: Target chain, contract identifiers, and diagnostic check configuration.

outputSchema.description: Diagnostic report with findings, severity, and recommended actions.

capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — diagnostics are pure read-side operations

capabilities.name: Anomaly Detection
capabilities.description: Detects anomalous on-chain behavior, unexpected state transitions, or security-relevant events on target chains.

inputSchema.description: Detection rules, chain event streams, and baseline behavior profiles.

outputSchema.description: Anomaly alerts with severity classification and evidence links.

capabilities.authentication: Read-only chain RPC and event stream access
capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — detection is event-driven and replayable

capabilities.name: Template Generation
capabilities.description: Generates deployment templates, contract scaffolding, and configuration artifacts for target chain environments.

inputSchema.description: Template parameters, target chain spec, and configuration overrides.

outputSchema.description: Generated template files ready for deployment execution.

capabilities.authentication: Local filesystem access (no remote auth required)
capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — template generation is deterministic for same inputs

capabilities.name: Devnet Provisioning
capabilities.description: Provisions local or remote development network environments for testing and integration.

inputSchema.description: Devnet configuration (chain params, funded accounts, contract pre-deploys).

outputSchema.description: Provisioned devnet endpoint and access credentials.

capabilities.retryability: destructive — retry tears down and recreates the devnet from scratch

capabilities.name: Chain-Specific Verification
capabilities.description: Verifies on-chain deployment state against the expected manifest, including contract code hashes, storage values, and transaction finality.

inputSchema.description: Deployment manifest with expected artifact checksums and contract references.

outputSchema.description: Chain-verified result with on-chain evidence and checksum comparisons.

capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — verification is deterministic against on-chain state

capabilities.name: Configuration Management
capabilities.description: Manages Orbit CLI configuration including initialization, validation, and environment-specific overrides.

inputSchema.description: Configuration file paths, environment variables, and validation rules.

capabilities.authentication: Local filesystem access (no remote auth required)
capabilities.retryability: safe to retry — config init/validate is deterministic

capabilities.name: Wallet Bootstrap
capabilities.description: Generates and manages operator wallet keys for chain-specific deployment authorization. Keys are non-custodial and scoped to deployment operations only.

inputSchema.description: Key generation parameters (curve, entropy source, output path).

capabilities.authentication: Local entropy and filesystem (no remote transmission of private keys)
capabilities.retryability: not retryable — key generation produces new material each invocation; lost keys cannot be recovered

sideEffectClasses.read: No persistent state mutation. Safe to invoke concurrently and repeatedly.
sideEffectClasses.write: Persistent state mutation. Requires idempotency guard or conditional retry logic.
sideEffectClasses.mixed: Both read and write. Requires careful retry semantics and state reconciliation.

authenticationTiers.platform-service-account: Platform CI/CD service accounts with repo-scoped tokens.
authenticationTiers.github-actions-oidc: GitHub Actions OIDC tokens with workload identity.
authenticationTiers.chain-deployer-key: Non-custodial chain-specific deployer keys (no protocol-signing custody).
authenticationTiers.chain-read-only: Read-only chain RPC access (no signing capability).
authenticationTiers.local-only: Local filesystem access only. No remote authentication.

retryabilitySemantics.idempotent: Safe to retry with identical inputs. Produces the same outcome.
retryabilitySemantics.safe-to-retry: No harmful side effects from repeated invocation.
retryabilitySemantics.conditional: Retry is safe only under specific preconditions (e.g., no prior on-chain confirmation).
retryabilitySemantics.destructive: Retry tears down and recreates state. Not safe for live environments.
retryabilitySemantics.not-retryable: Each invocation produces unique, non-recoverable output.
